interface.shortDescription: Codebase intelligence — semantic search, symbol inspection, and bounded repository analysis
interface.longDescription: LLM-Knowledge-Graph provides codebase intelligence through semantic search, symbol inspection, and bounded repository analysis. Index your codebase, search with hybrid semantic + keyword search, inspect grounded symbol details, and run bounded entrypoint, flow, impact, and slice analysis.
defaultPrompt: Use LLM-Knowledge-Graph to inspect the symbol details for the authentication entrypoint.
Use LLM-Knowledge-Graph to trace the bounded flow from a request handler to its downstream calls.
